pipeline.name: Name
pipeline.listChanged: The order changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.

errors.nameInvalid: The name must be between 1 and 60 characters.
errors.probabilityInvalid: The probability must be between 0 and 100%.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: The board's columns, in this order. “Won” stages ({won}) count as won deals in the funnel, and moving a deal to a “Lost” stage asks for the loss reason.
stages.descriptionNoWon: The board's columns, in this order. “Won” stages count as won deals in the funnel, and moving a deal to a “Lost” stage asks for the loss reason.
stages.addDescription: It goes before the first won stage. You can move it afterwards.
stages.editDescription: You can change the name and probability whenever you like. The type only while the stage has no deals.
stages.probabilityHint: Used for deals in this stage that don't have their own. It weights the pipeline.

kindHints.open: The deal is still in play.
kindHints.won: Counts as a won deal in the funnel.
kindHints.lost: Moving a deal here asks for the loss reason.

onlyOfKind.open: It's the only open stage: there must always be at least one open, one won and one lost stage.
onlyOfKind.won: It's the only won stage: there must always be at least one open, one won and one lost stage.
onlyOfKind.lost: It's the only lost stage: there must always be at least one open, one won and one lost stage.

stages.kindLocked: It already has deals (archived ones count too), so its type can't change. If you need to, create another stage and archive this one.
stages.archiveHasDeals: {count, plural, one {It has # deal: move it} other {It has # deals: move them}} to another stage before archiving it.
stages.archiveBody: It will disappear from the board and no deal can be moved to it. The history and the funnel keep it.
stages.notFound: That stage no longer exists or has been archived. Reload the page.
stages.duplicateName: There's already a stage with that name.

sources.title: Acquisition sources
sources.description: Where each deal comes from. An archived source stays on the deals that already have it, but can't be chosen for new ones.
sources.archiveBody: Deals that already have it keep it, but it can't be chosen for new deals.
sources.notFound: That source no longer exists or has been archived. Reload the page.
sources.duplicateName: There's already a source with that name.
sources.empty: No sources. Add the first one.

reasons.title: Loss reasons
reasons.description: Asked for when a deal moves to a lost stage, they feed the funnel's top reasons. An archived one stays on deals already lost, but can't be chosen for new ones.
reasons.archiveBody: Deals lost for this reason keep it, but it can't be chosen when marking a new one as lost.
reasons.lastOne: There must be at least one reason: without any, a deal couldn't be marked as lost.
reasons.notFound: That reason no longer exists or has been archived. Reload the page.
reasons.duplicateName: There's already a reason with that name.
reasons.empty: No reasons. Add the first one.
